Theo Luật Bảo hiểm xã hội 2024 (hiệu lực: Under Vietnam's 2024 Social Insurance Law (effective 1 July 2025), common cases include:
Đủ tuổi nghỉ hưu nhưng chưa đủ 15 năm đó: Reaching retirement age with fewer than 15 years of contributions and not continuing to contribute.
Đang mắc một trong các bệnh nguy hiểm đế: Having one of the life-threatening illnesses listed in the law (such as cancer, polio or decompensated cirrhosis).
Người bắt đầu tham gia BHXH trước 01/07/: People who started contributing before 1 July 2025, have not paid compulsory or voluntary social insurance for 12 months, and have fewer than 20 years of contributions.
